artifacts.purpose: Full folder tree + per-file code placement specs (600 lines)
Contracts, pipeline events, detector/OCR/matcher rules, confidence model, module boundaries, perf contract
Test matrix, fixtures manifest protocol, delivery checklist, timing report template
Stack summary, workflow, behavior guarantees, verification pointers, status table

keyDecisions: Shared types centralized in src/types/contracts.ts (Detection, ProductMatch, PipelineEvent union)
Pipeline emits only: loading-model/downloading-model → detecting → detected → reading-label → ocr-start/ocr-end → identified → matching → done | error
ONNX meta sidecar public/models/groceries.onnx.meta.json is single source of truth for class index order (must match scripts/prompts.py)
Confidence: packaged round(100*(0.65*detection+0.25*ocr+0.10*margin)); produce renormalizes to detection 0.65/0.75 + margin 0.10/0.75
OCR budget 4 crops / 8s, non-blocking done; skip produce; skip <60px height after enhanced attempts
Matcher never uses catalog popularity for specificity; conflicts collapse to shared parentName
No .pt on client; seg-ONNX box-only fallback documented in export meta
Module boundary: inference/* must not import React; UI never calls YLO.load/tesseract directly

entrypoints: src/types/contracts.ts then src/inference/* pure modules then context/pages/components
tests/unit/matcher.*.test.ts and confidence.ranking.test.ts first (pure, no DOM)
constraints: No hosted AI APIs, no backend, no WebGPU requirement
Netlify static only; SPA redirect for /results
>=60 catalog entries with real sources; never fabricate SKUs
Report real timings; iPhone unverified unless physical device used
risks: YOLOE detection-only ONNX export may fail -> seg fallback boxes path must be verified with onnxruntime
tesseract.js cold wasm/traineddata download on first scan must have progress + retry UX
iOS EXIF createImageBitmap imageOrientation support varies; canvas fallback required
ONNX file size may force artifact-not-git strategy on Netlify

resources.reason: Requirements fully specified by user; documentation authored sequentially by orchestrator (no research gap)
